title: Game News Round-Up
summary: Daily curated games-industry news digest for 30 July 2026.

items.title: After dissolution of the original team, a **Wuchang: Fallen Feathers** sequel has been confirmed with the original creative director at the helm
bullets: Previous reports claimed that Xia Siyuan had been fired from Leenzee earlier this year. It was also claimed a majority of the studio was laid off after refusing to switch to an outsourcing model

items.title: **TaleWorlds** Entertainment co-founder İpek Yavuz has passed away
bullets: Yavuz co-founded the Mount & Blade studio in 2005 alongside her husband Armagan Yavuz

items.title: The Simpsons' Reload mode in **Fortnite** adds a Simpson-ified John Wick as an unlockable skin
bullets: This marks the fourth Keanu Reeves skin available in Fortnite (John Wick, John Wick Pen & Ink Variant, Johnny Silverhand)
The current battle pass is required to unlock the skin

items.title: **Krafton** Q2 Results
bullets: Operating profit rose 67% to ₩410.9 billion ($283.1 million)
Subnautica and PUBG were the primary drivers of PC revenue growth, which surpassed ₩500 billion ($344.4 million) for the first time
Console revenue rose 143.3% year-over-year to ₩23.8 billion ($16.3 million), while mobile revenue increased slightly by 5.5% to ₩451 billion ($310.7 million)
